services.title: The Right Solar Solution for Every Energy Requirement.
paragraphs: Whether you're powering a family home, managing a commercial property or planning energy infrastructure for an industrial facility, we help you identify and implement a solution suited to your needs.

items.title: Residential Solar Installation
items.tagline: Make Reliable Power Part of Everyday Living.
paragraphs: Your home depends on electricity for lighting, refrigeration, internet connectivity, entertainment and everyday comfort.
We design and install residential solar systems around your household's electricity consumption, essential appliances and preferred backup duration.
From solar panels and hybrid inverters to battery storage and system configuration, we help you make an informed investment in dependable home energy.

items.title: Commercial Solar Installation
items.tagline: Keep Your Business Moving With Smarter Energy.
paragraphs: Electricity interruptions and generator expenses can affect business productivity, customer experience and operating costs.
We provide commercial solar solutions for offices, retail businesses, hotels, schools, healthcare facilities and other commercial properties.
Each system is planned around the building's electricity demand, operating hours and existing power infrastructure.

items.title: Industrial Solar Solutions
items.tagline: Power Solutions Built Around Industrial Demands.
paragraphs: Manufacturing facilities, warehouses and industrial operations require careful energy planning to support equipment, production processes and daily operations.
We develop industrial solar solutions that can supplement existing electricity sources, reduce generator dependence and support selected operational loads.
From site assessment and system planning to installation and integration, our approach considers energy demand, existing infrastructure and future capacity requirements.

items.title: Hybrid Solar & Inverter Systems
items.tagline: Flexible Power From More Than One Source.
paragraphs: A hybrid solar system brings together solar generation, inverter technology, battery storage and compatible grid or generator supply.
This allows energy from different sources to be managed according to the system configuration and available power.
We help customers select and install hybrid inverter systems suited to their electricity requirements, backup expectations and existing infrastructure.

items.title: Solar Battery Storage Solutions
items.tagline: Store Energy for When You Need It.
paragraphs: Solar panels generate electricity during daylight hours, but your energy needs continue after sunset.
Battery storage makes it possible to use stored electricity at night or during grid interruptions, subject to available charge and system capacity.
We provide battery storage solutions designed to work with compatible inverters and meet your energy requirements.

items.title: Solar Maintenance & System Upgrades
items.tagline: Protect Your Solar Investment for the Long Term.
paragraphs: A solar installation requires appropriate care to maintain effective performance.
We provide solar system inspection, maintenance, troubleshooting and upgrade support to help identify developing issues and keep equipment operating as intended.
Where your energy requirements have changed, we can assess your existing installation and recommend suitable improvements or expansion options.

system.title: From Sunlight to Usable Power. See How It Works.
paragraphs: Solar energy becomes more valuable when you understand how electricity is generated, stored and used throughout the day.
Explore how a suitably configured solar system can support your building under different electricity conditions.

items.title: DAYTIME
items.tagline: Make the Most of Available Sunlight.
paragraphs: During daylight hours, solar panels generate electricity that can be converted by the inverter to power your building. Depending on your system design and electricity demand, surplus solar energy may also charge the battery.

items.title: NIGHT-TIME
items.tagline: Stored Energy When the Sun Goes Down.
paragraphs: At night, solar generation stops. A system equipped with sufficient battery storage can supply electricity to your connected appliances and equipment, depending on the energy available.

items.title: POWER OUTAGE
items.tagline: Backup Power When the Grid Is Unavailable.
paragraphs: With a properly configured hybrid or off-grid system, available solar generation and stored battery energy can support designated electrical loads during a grid outage.

decisions.title: When Your Power Needs Change, Your Energy Strategy Should Too.
paragraphs: There are many reasons to consider solar power. The important question is whether the proposed system will address your actual electricity requirements and provide practical long-term value.

items.title: Your Generator Is Becoming Expensive to Run
paragraphs: Frequent generator use can result in significant spending on fuel, servicing and repairs. A suitable solar system may reduce generator operating hours and associated costs.

items.title: Power Interruptions Are Affecting Your Activities
paragraphs: If unreliable electricity is interrupting business operations or essential household activities, a properly sized solar and battery solution may provide useful backup capacity.

items.title: Your Electricity Demand Is Increasing
paragraphs: New equipment, additional appliances and business expansion can change how much power you need. An energy assessment helps determine whether solar can meet part or all of that demand.

items.title: You're Building or Upgrading a Property
paragraphs: Planning solar infrastructure during construction or renovation can make it easier to consider installation space, electrical integration and future energy requirements.

items.title: You Need Power Where Grid Access Is Limited
paragraphs: Off-grid solar systems may provide a practical electricity solution for properties, farms and facilities without dependable access to the national grid.

items.title: Your Existing Solar System No Longer Meets Your Needs
paragraphs: An undersized system, ageing battery storage or changing energy consumption may justify an inspection, upgrade or redesign.

faq.title: Everything You Need to Know Before Going Solar.

items.title: How much does solar installation cost in Nigeria?
paragraphs: The cost depends on the size of the system, your electricity consumption, the inverter and battery capacity, solar panel requirements and installation conditions. An energy assessment helps determine the equipment needed and provides a basis for an accurate quotation.

items.title: What size of solar system do I need for my home or business?
paragraphs: The right size depends on your appliances, daily electricity consumption, peak loads and required backup duration. A professional load assessment helps identify a suitable system rather than relying on the number of rooms or building size alone.

items.title: Can solar power run air conditioners and heavy appliances?
paragraphs: Yes, provided the system has sufficient inverter, solar and battery capacity for those appliances. Equipment with high running loads or starting currents requires careful system sizing.

items.title: Will solar power work during the rainy season?
paragraphs: Yes. Solar panels can generate electricity in cloudy and rainy conditions, although production is generally lower than during strong sunshine. The system design should consider seasonal changes in solar generation.

items.title: What is the difference between hybrid, off-grid and grid-tied solar systems?
paragraphs: A hybrid system combines solar generation with battery storage and can integrate with the grid or other backup sources. An off-grid system operates independently of the electricity grid. A grid-tied system uses solar alongside grid electricity and typically requires additional backup equipment to operate during a grid outage.

items.title: Can I use solar power alongside my existing generator?
paragraphs: Yes. Some hybrid inverter systems support generator integration. Compatibility, switching arrangements and system configuration must be assessed before installation.

items.title: How long do solar panels and batteries last?
paragraphs: Quality solar panels are commonly designed for a service life of approximately 25–30 years, although performance gradually changes over time. Battery lifespan depends on the battery technology, usage, operating conditions and manufacturer specifications.

items.title: Can I expand my solar system later?
paragraphs: In many cases, yes. However, expansion depends on inverter capacity, equipment compatibility, available installation space and the existing electrical configuration. Future needs should ideally be considered during the initial design.

items.title: Does a solar system require maintenance?
paragraphs: Yes. Solar systems benefit from periodic inspection, performance monitoring, equipment checks and appropriate panel cleaning. Maintenance requirements depend on the installation environment and equipment specifications.

items.title: How do I get started with Integrated Solutions Technology?
paragraphs: Contact us with your property location, electricity needs and the appliances or equipment you intend to power. We can discuss your requirements, determine whether a site assessment is necessary and recommend the next steps towards a suitable solar solution.
